notes.title: Demo build updated
notes.content:
Change Log:

V1.01
- Bug fixed which could crash game if you go to very specific location in one room
- Fixed bug where you could exit cells room from any position
- Missing walk-behind area added
- Wilson text location corrected
- Wildekimbo dialogue option switching off appropriately that was remaining on
- Extra comment by player in one dialogue to point player towards their next step
- Added interaction responses to pipe
- Added extra reaction to book interaction
- Added extra explanatory reaction in ContainerBot dialogue
- Added change speed option for power cell mini-game


It is probable that if you have an old savegame for the demo from v1.00 that it will no longer work with the new version of the demo. Sorry about that, but since it's quite a small demo and cut-scenes / dialogues are skippable, it really shouldn't take long to get back to where you were.
